spaces.text: Start your journey through the Autumn Forest!
What is your favorite autumn activity and why?
Describe your favorite animal using 3 adjectives.
🍄 Mushroom Patch! Slip on a damp mushroom. Go back 2 spaces.
Talk about your best friend. What do you like doing together?
🌰 Lucky Acorn! You found a crunchy treat. Move forward 1 space.
What do you usually eat for breakfast on cold autumn mornings?
🍂 Swirling Leaf! A gust of autumn wind boosts you! Take a bonus roll!
Which season do you like best: Autumn, Winter, Spring, or Summer?
🦔 Sleepy Hedgehog! You stopped to nap in warm leaves. Skip your next turn.
Tell us about something fun you did last weekend.
🦉 Wise Owl! Wisdom share: Ask another player any question in English!
Name 3 things you can see in an autumn forest.
🐿️ Squirrel Sprint! Dash along the treetops! Move forward 2 spaces.
What is your favorite book, movie, or fairy tale?
🎭 Forest Charades! Act out your favorite animal without speaking for 20 seconds!
What clothes do you wear when it rains outside?
🌰 Heavy Acorn! Your backpack is too heavy. Go back 1 space.
If you could have any superpower in the forest, what would it be?
What are you looking forward to doing this month?
🎉 You made it through the Autumn Forest! Congratulations!
